description: This file defines a Android Fragment class named CardStreamFragment which manages a stream of card UI components. It provides functionality to add, show, hide, dismiss, and restore cards within a user interface, handling their visibility and dismissibility states. The class also supports state dumping and restoration to preserve UI state across lifecycle events.

classes.name: CardStreamFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages a dynamic stream of card views, including adding, removing, showing, hiding, dismissing, and restoring cards, with support for dismissible cards and state preservation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes the card stream layout, setting up the dismiss listener.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a card to the stream, initially hidden if not already present.

methods.name: addCard (overloaded)
methods.description: Adds a card to the stream and optionally shows it.

methods.name: removeCard
methods.description: Removes a card from the stream by its tag, including from the layout if visible.

methods.name: showCard
methods.description: Shows a hidden card and makes it visible in the layout.

methods.name: showCard (overloaded)
methods.description: Shows a card with dismissibility specified.

methods.name: hideCard
methods.description: Hides a visible card, removing it from the layout.

methods.name: dismissCard
methods.description: Internal method to handle the dismissal of a card, moving it to the hidden state.

methods.name: isCardVisible
methods.description: Checks if a card is currently visible.

methods.name: isCardDismissible
methods.description: Checks if a card is dismissible.

methods.name: getCard
methods.description: Retrieves the Card object associated with a given tag.

methods.name: setFirstVisibleCard
methods.description: Scrolls the view to show the specified card.

methods.name: getVisibleCardCount
methods.description: Returns the number of visible cards.

methods.name: getVisibleCards
methods.description: Returns a collection of all visible Card objects.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the fragment's card stream state from a saved state object.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Serializes the current card stream state into a CardStreamState object.
